subproblem.title: Finite boundary mass of a slice-composed current via the slice homotopy identities
subproblem.statement: Notation: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} for t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N; Jv := ι(0, v) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) := TestFormOn univ m and 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) := GeometricCurrentOn univ m (forms and currents on all of ℝ^P = Euclid P); M(T) := T.mass = T.massOn univ; spt T := T.support. d := exteriorDerivative. Assume (MSB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and c ∈ ℝ with |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X).toReal; (SLB): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, s ∈ ℝ and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}) there is ρ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with ρ(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all x, v; (SLC): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, one has for all x and v = (v_0, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_k) dt = β(ι(1, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − β(ι(0, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − dθ(x)(v); (SLD): for all N, β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}), x ∈ ℝ^N and the empty tuple v: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt = β(ι(1, x))() − β(ι(0, x))(); (R2): for all N, k there is a continuous linear map Ψ from k-covectors on ℝ^{N+1} to k-covectors on ℝ^N with Ψ(γ)(v_1, …, v_k) = γ(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) and |Ψ(γ)| ≤ |γ|. Let N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (that is, M(∂X) < ∞ when k ≥ 1; it is 0 when k = 0), Z ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}), and maps S_m : 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) → 𝒟^m(ℝ^N) (m ∈ ℕ) such that for every m: S_m(ω)(x)(v_1, …, v_m) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_m) dt for all ω, x, v, and |S_m(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x whenever c ∈ ℝ and |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y. If Z(ω) = X(S_k(ω)) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}), then M(∂Z) < ∞.

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof. Let B := 2·M(X).toReal + (boundaryMassOn X univ).toReal. M(∂Z) = M_univ(∂Z) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(∂Z(ω)) over the admissible ω, namely ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}) with tsupport ω ⊆ univ and |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y. Fix such an ω.
1. Boundary value. ∂Z(ω) = Z(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply), where dω := exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) has underlying form exteriorDerivative ω. By the hypothesis on Z, ∂Z(ω) = X(S_k(dω)).
2. The end slices. For s ∈ {0, 1}, (SLB) with dimension N, degree k, this s and ω gives ρ_s ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with ρ_s(x)(v) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all x, v. Take Ψ from (R2) for (N, k). For each x, the covectors ρ_s(x) and Ψ(ω(ι(s, x))) agree on every tuple v (both equal ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k)), so they are equal (ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext), and |ρ_s(x)| = |Ψ(ω(ι(s, x)))| ≤ |ω(ι(s, x))| ≤ 1. As this holds at every x, in particular on spt X, (MSB) with c = 1 gives |X(ρ_s)| ≤ M(X).toReal for s = 0 and s = 1.
3. Case k = 0. Here ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}). For every x and the empty tuple v, the slice formula for S_0 applied to dω gives S_0(dω)(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dω(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt, and (SLD) with β := ω turns this into ω(ι(1, x))() − ω(ι(0, x))() = ρ₁(x)(v) − ρ₀(x)(v). Hence S_0(dω) = ρ₁ − ρ₀ (equal values at every x and v; ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext and Subtype.ext). By linearity of X, ∂Z(ω) = X(ρ₁ − ρ₀) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) ≤ |X(ρ₁)| + |X(ρ₀)| ≤ 2·M(X).toReal ≤ B, since (boundaryMassOn X univ).toReal ≥ 0.
4. Case k = k' + 1. Here ω ∈ 𝒟^{k'+1}(ℝ^{N+1}). Put θ := S_{k'}(ω) ∈ 𝒟^{k'}(ℝ^N). By the slice formula for S_{k'}, θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_{k'}) dt for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k'}, which is exactly the hypothesis of (SLC) with degree k', β := ω and this θ. So for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k'+1}, using the slice formula for S_{k'+1} applied to dω and then (SLC): S_{k'+1}(dω)(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_{k'}) dt = ω(ι(1, x))(Jv) − ω(ι(0, x))(Jv) − dθ(x)(v) = (ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ)(x)(v), where dθ := exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k' θ. Therefore S_{k'+1}(dω) = ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ, and by linearity of X, ∂Z(ω) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − X(dθ), where X(dθ) = ∂X(θ) by the definition of the boundary. The bound hypothesis on S_{k'} with c = 1 (|ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y) gives |θ(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. In positive degree boundaryMassOn X univ is by definition M_univ(∂X) = M(∂X), which is finite by hypothesis, so (MSB) for the current ∂X ∈ 𝒟_{k'}(ℝ^N), ψ := θ and c = 1 gives |∂X(θ)| ≤ M(∂X).toReal = (boundaryMassOn X univ).toReal. Hence ∂Z(ω) ≤ |X(ρ₁)| + |X(ρ₀)| + |∂X(θ)| ≤ B.
5. Conclusion. In both cases ∂Z(ω) ≤ B for every admissible ω, so ENNReal.ofReal(∂Z(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(B) (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal). Taking the supremum (sSup_le), M(∂Z) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(B) < ∞ (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top). □
Lean remarks: split with `cases k` after fixing ω; in the successor case boundaryMassOn X univ unfolds by rfl to X.boundary.mass. A direct `rw [map_sub]` on `X.toCurrent (ρ₁ - ρ₀)` may fail to find its pattern; state `X (ρ₁ - ρ₀) = X ρ₁ - X ρ₀` separately from `map_sub X.toCurrent ρ₁ ρ₀` and rewrite with that equation.
proof_key_steps: End slices ρ_s from (SLB) satisfy ρ_s(x) = Ψ(ω(ι(s, x))), so |ρ_s| ≤ 1 and |X(ρ_s)| ≤ M(X).toReal by (MSB).
k = 0: S_0(dω) = ρ₁ − ρ₀ by (SLD), so ∂Z(ω) ≤ 2·M(X).toReal.
k = k' + 1: with θ := S_{k'}(ω), (SLC) gives S_{k'+1}(dω) = ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ, so ∂Z(ω) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − ∂X(θ), and |θ| ≤ 1 with (MSB) for ∂X gives ∂Z(ω) ≤ 2·M(X).toReal + M(∂X).toReal.
Taking the supremum over admissible ω: M(∂Z) ≤ ofReal(2·M(X).toReal + (boundaryMassOn X univ).toReal) < ∞.
